compileAttempt1.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$unityPath='D:\Unity\UnityClient\2022.3.18f1\Editor\Unity.exe'
$projectPath='D:\Unity\UnityProj\FightMatch'
$logPath='D:\Unity\UnityProj\FightMatch\Logs\FMDemoB08Compile.log'
if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $unityPath -PathType Leaf)){throw 'Unity executable missing'}
$running=@(Get-Process -Name Unity -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
if($running.Count -ne 0){$running | Select-Object Id,Path,MainWindowTitle | ConvertTo-Json -Compress;throw 'BLOCKED: Unity already running'}
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $logPath){throw 'B08 compile log already exists'}
$scope=Get-Content -LiteralPath 'docs/system-design/2026-09-17/demo-012-scope.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
foreach($entry in $scope.codeFreeze.files){if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $entry.path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -cne $entry.sha256){throw 'Frozen source changed'}}
$started=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
$compileProcess=Start-Process -FilePath $unityPath -ArgumentList @('-batchmode','-nographics','-quit','-projectPath',$projectPath,'-logFile',$logPath) -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
[pscustomobject]@{event='started';kind='compile';pid=$compileProcess.Id;startedAtUtc=$started;unityPath=$unityPath;projectPath=$projectPath;logPath=$logPath} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
$compileProcess.WaitForExit()
$compileProcess.Refresh()
$actualExit=$compileProcess.ExitCode
[pscustomobject]@{event='completed';kind='compile';pid=$compileProcess.Id;startedAtUtc=$started;completedAtUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o');actualUnityExitCode=$actualExit} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
exit $actualExit
